visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a dimly lit indoor bedroom environment. A woman with long dark hair and glasses is lying on a patterned bedspread next to a sleeping infant who is nestled under a thick blanket. She is wearing a beige sweater and makes a playful eating gesture toward the camera with a weary but smiling expression. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit kitchen. A male hand reaches into a freezer drawer filled with various frozen food packages and pulls out a large blue bag specifically labeled for shrimp. The shot focuses on the frozen texture of the bag against the metallic freezer interior. (3) Food preparation is shown in a series of close-ups. Sliced green onions and ginger strips are organized on a white ceramic plate. Another plate holds raw, greyish shrimp that have been peeled. A hand holds up a single shrimp to demonstrate that the intestinal vein has been meticulously removed. (4) Cooking occurs in a large black metal wok. Clear oil is poured in, followed by ginger and then the shrimp shells/heads to flavor the oil. Once fried, the shells are removed and the de-veined shrimp bodies are added, quickly turning from grey to a vibrant orange-red color under high heat. (5) In the final phase, the woman and a man with glasses are standing in a well-lit living area. The woman, now wearing a black jacket over her sweater, uses chopsticks to eat the cooked shrimp from a black plate. They both smile and gesture enthusiastically at the camera, showing off the completed dish.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal male voice narration characterized by a rapid speech rate and an enthusiastic tone. An upbeat, electronic pop background music (BGM) with a steady 4/4 drum beat and bright synth pads supports the vocal. (2) A sharp mechanical sliding sound occurs as a freezer drawer opens, followed immediately by the high-pitched, crinkling texture of a plastic bag being manipulated. The narrator continues his energetic delivery without pause, maintaining the high-tempo flow. (3) The acoustic environment shifts to incorporate high-frequency broadband sizzling as ingredients hit hot oil. Periodic percussive 'clinks' of a spatula striking a metal wok provide rhythmic accents to the soundscape, while the BGM remains a constant layer. (4) A heavy 'thud' and intensive stir-fry sounds (scraping and sizzling) dominate the mix during the cooking sequence. The narrator's pitch rises to convey excitement. Short 'whoosh' sound effects are used to transition between these quick culinary actions. (5) A cheerful female voice enters the dialogue with a bright, positive valence. Sounds of clear laughter and subtle munching occur as they taste the food. The male and female voices overlap in a friendly, high-energy conversation over the persistent, upbeat BGM.
